summary: Full smoke test of Help, Querido Dante portal. Backend: auth (login/me/wrong-pw), portal-config (public GET + admin PUT + 401 without token), seeds verified (4/2/6/4/2/3), CRUD playlist full cycle (create/update/delete/401 no-auth), lead create, admin leads list, dante-config GET. Dante chat endpoint EXISTS and validates payload (422 on missing fields, 502 on valid payload due to Emergent LLM budget=0 — expected per main agent note). Frontend: Portal home renders all 6 testids; /suicidio renders all 9 testids (tabs/filters work); Dante modal opens, pre-chat form fills and submits, transitions to chat screen. Admin login OK; dashboard shows all portal fields and subtabs, save persists (toast 'Salvo!' visible); Add Playlist modal opens with correct schema fields.
passed: PUT /api/portal-config with admin persists; without token returns 401
Seeds: playlists=4, videos=2, action-cards=6, emergency-channels=4, psychologists=2, laws=3
Playlist CRUD full cycle (POST/PUT/DELETE) works with admin; POST without token returns 401
POST /api/dante/chat endpoint contract validates payload (422 on missing fields; 502 upstream when payload valid — LLM budget issue documented)
Frontend Portal / renders: btn-quick-exit, btn-prevention, btn-book-site, btn-about, btn-terms, footer-text
Frontend /suicidio renders: btn-back-portal, tab-fazer/nao-fazer, tab-preciso/alguem, filter-todos/lei/diretriz, btn-dante-open; tab and filter switching works
Dante modal opens; pre-chat validates and submits; chat screen with input-dante-message + btn-dante-send visible; lead persisted via API
Admin login OK; dashboard shows tab-portal, tab-categorias, btn-logout, btn-credentials
Portal admin tab shows input-book-url/footer/about/terms/btn-save-portal; save shows 'Salvo!' toast
btn-add-Playlist opens modal with Categoria/Nome/Cantor/Link YouTube fields matching backend schema

failed.issue: POST /api/dante/chat returns 502 Bad Gateway because Emergent LLM key has Max budget: 0. Endpoint code path OK, only upstream LLM call fails.
failed.evidence: backend.err.log: 'litellm.RateLimitError: Budget has been exceeded! Key=daatki1qna4s73bssrr0 Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'

action_items: None blocking. Optionally consider handling the LLM ChatError in /api/dante/chat to return a graceful JSON 500/503 with detail instead of letting the exception propagate and yield a Cloudflare 502 (better UX for chat UI).
Provide a valid xAI or Emergent LLM key with budget > 0 to enable actual Dante conversations.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 tested endpoints; dante/chat contract-only as instructed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Portal, /suicidio, Dante modal, Admin login/dashboard/CRUD-open all verified)

notes: Two Playwright interactions timed out due to test-script conditions (btn-dante-open has ribbon-pulse CSS animation triggering 'element not stable'; subtab-dante click was blocked because Add Playlist Dialog overlay was still open). Neither indicates an app defect — all state before those points was validated OK. Not retried per loop-prevention policy.
